description: This Java source file defines a final class 'RetrieveStatisticsDetailsResponseSupplier' that implements a functional interface to supply 'RetrieveStatisticsDetailsResponse' objects for a specific Akka shard region. It retrieves shard region state asynchronously via pattern ask, processes shard data to compute statistics grouped by namespace or resource type, and constructs JSON responses accordingly.

classes.description: A supplier class that provides 'RetrieveStatisticsDetailsResponse' objects for a specific shard region by querying Akka cluster shard region state and aggregating shard entity IDs into statistical JSON reports.
